title: Horror Overview
subtitle: A horror investigation starter with Terminal, Index, SoundCore, Lens, MissionCore, and HoloMap.
summary: A generic station, signal, and evidence mystery starter with restrained ambience, Lens scans, archives, and objective tracking.
body:
Investigate a signal, scan evidence, open an archive, follow a marker, recover a log, and survive the first event.

First 30 minutes:
- Read the signal investigation page.
- Scan one evidence object.
- Open the first archive entry.
- Follow a HoloMap marker to the next clue.

First 2 hours:
- Add optional Stationfall or Blackbox content if the pack needs deeper horror systems.
- Tune SoundCore ambience so it supports tension without constant noise.
- Keep mission feedback clear when players miss evidence.
